projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: A simple, sleek weather app designed with React Native (Expo). The UI focuses on clean, attractive design, displaying essential weather details like temperature, location, and weather conditions.
projects.longDescription: This weather application provides real-time weather updates with a beautiful, intuitive interface. Built with React Native and Expo, it features dynamic background changes based on current weather conditions, 5-day forecasts, and severe weather alerts. The app uses the OpenWeatherMap API to fetch accurate weather data for locations worldwide.
features: Dynamic UI changes based on weather

projects.title: E-commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-featured e-commerce platform with product listings, cart functionality, and secure checkout.
projects.longDescription: This comprehensive e-commerce solution includes product catalog management, user authentication, shopping cart functionality, and secure payment processing. Built with MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), it provides a seamless shopping experience with features like product search, filters, user reviews, and order tracking.
features: Product catalog with search and filters

projects.title: Task Management Dashboard
projects.description: Productivity application for task management with team collaboration features.
projects.longDescription: This task management solution helps individuals and teams organize their work with features like task assignment, due dates, priority levels, and progress tracking. The application includes real-time updates, notifications, and integrations with calendar apps. Built with Vue.js and Firebase for real-time data synchronization.
